title: Investigating the Effects of Fairness Interventions Using Pointwise Representational Similarity

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating representational shifts in tabular data using Pointwise Normalized Kernel Alignment (PNKA) and assessing downstream prediction outcomes (e.g., statistical parity, precision) on the COMPAS dataset across Caucasian and non-Caucasian groups.

Applying PNKA to measure representational changes in the Adult tabular dataset, and assessing static and contextualized language embeddings by computing projections and cosine similarities against canonical gender vectors using the SemBias and SEAT datasets.
